Saudi Arabia Faces Houthi Attacks Amid Regional Security Pledges

Saudi Arabia's King Salman has condemned Houthi attacks targeting the kingdom, including a missile strike near Mecca, which he described as 'terrorist'. The attacks are forcing Pakistan to confront its new collective-security pledge with Saudi Arabia, as Houthi missiles are hitting deep inside Saudi territory. This situation highlights a sense of urgency in the kingdom amid escalated attacks from Yemen.
